tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Ticket Buying Simulation
tickets.description:
There are n people standing in a queue where the ith person wants to buy tickets[i] tickets.

Each person can buy only one ticket at a time. After buying a ticket, they move to the end of the queue if they still need more tickets.

Return the time taken for the person at index k to finish buying tickets.

**Input Format:**
Array tickets and integer k.

**Output Format:**
Return total time for person k to finish buying tickets.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Students Unable to Eat Lunch
tickets.description:
A group of students stand in a queue to receive lunch. Each student prefers either circular (0) or square (1) sandwiches. The sandwiches are placed in a stack.

At each step:
- If the student at the front prefers the sandwich on top of the stack, they take it and leave.
- Otherwise, they move to the end of the queue.

This continues until no student wants the top sandwich.

Return the number of students unable to eat.

**Input Format:**
Two arrays: students and sandwiches.

**Output Format:**
Return the number of students unable to eat.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Reveal Cards in Increasing Order
tickets.description:
You are given an integer array deck representing a deck of unique cards.

You must arrange the deck so that when you repeatedly reveal the top card and move the next card to the bottom, the revealed cards appear in increasing order.

Return the ordering of the deck that achieves this.

**Input Format:**
Array deck of unique integers.

**Output Format:**
Return arranged deck.

tickets.title: Ticket 4 — Winner of the Circular Game
tickets.description:
There are n friends standing in a circle. Starting from the first friend, count k people clockwise including the current one. The kth friend leaves the circle.

The process continues until only one person remains.

Return the winner.

**Input Format:**
Two integers n and k.

**Output Format:**
Return the winner.

tickets.title: Ticket 5 — Dota2 Senate Simulation
tickets.description:
In the Dota2 Senate, there are two parties: Radiant (R) and Dire (D). Each senator can ban a senator from the opposing party.

The senators vote in rounds. Each senator can ban one opponent who appears later in the voting order. If a senator is banned, they cannot vote in future rounds.

Given a string senate representing the parties of senators, determine which party will win the game.

**Input Format:**
String senate containing 'R' and 'D'.

**Output Format:**
Return the winning party name.

tickets.title: Ticket 6 — Circular Petrol Pump Tour
tickets.description:
There are N petrol pumps arranged in a circle. Each pump provides a certain amount of petrol and the truck requires a certain amount of petrol to reach the next pump.

Find the index of the first petrol pump from which the truck can complete the circular tour without running out of petrol.

**Input Format:**
Array where each element is [petrol, distance].

**Output Format:**
Return starting petrol pump index.

tickets.title: Ticket 7 — Castle on the Grid
tickets.description:
You are given a square grid where each cell is either open '.' or blocked 'X'. You can move like a rook in chess (any number of steps horizontally or vertically until blocked).

Find the minimum number of moves required to go from the start cell to the goal cell.

**Input Format:**
Grid matrix with start and goal coordinates.

**Output Format:**
Return minimum number of moves.
